method: AgriciDaniel's SEO audit, technical and international workflows, checked against Google Search Central. The production sample used canonical URLs from robots.txt, the sitemap and the guide registry.

pages: Guide index and four articles in each sampled guide locale
English and Arabic home and support pages

findings.evidence: On every sampled guide index the H1 was a translated two-part slogan. The existing title had a clear topic description.
findings.change: Use the localized page title without its brand suffix as the page heading.
findings.verification: Compare the title and H1 in every exported guide index.

findings.evidence: Guide cards appeared in an ungrouped sequence. Readers had to scan the whole index for school, app blocking or task planning topics.
findings.change: Group all guide cards into three labeled sections with plain anchor navigation and descriptive article links.
findings.verification: Check that each index links to every available guide once as a heading. Follow the topic links in mobile and RTL layouts.

findings.evidence: Localized guide index sitemap entries omitted lastmod.
findings.change: Record the date of the navigation update for the 47 affected index URLs.
findings.verification: Check that the date appears on each guide index entry and that the sitemap still lists only canonical public pages.
